scope: Tiny paired local contracts;root-owned runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Parse offset evidence into comparable instants
cases.input_contract: Return event_id, text, event_time by parsing the declared offset pattern yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss with a literal T and XXX offset. The session timestamp type must be LTZ.
cases.expected: All 6 rows parse. Epoch(event 2)=epoch(event 5), and epoch(event 3)-epoch(event 2)=3600 seconds.
cases.verification: Assert TimestampType, zero null timestamps, exact same-instant equality and the 3600-second separation.

cases.title: Render a zone without changing the underlying instant
cases.input_contract: Return ordered(event_id, formatted_clock) pairs for a requested zone, formatting yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss. Set the zone only during materialization and restore the previous setting in finally.
cases.expected: Events 2 and 3 render 08:30 and 09:30 underUTC but both 01:30 underAmerica/Los_Angeles. Session zone is UTC afterward.
cases.verification: Assert both full clock strings for IDs 2/3 and the restored session configuration.

cases.title: Filter a complete local day with instant boundaries
cases.input_contract: Select events in the half-open interval[2024-11-03T07:00:00Z,2024-11-04T08:00:00Z). Return all event columns.
cases.expected: Ordered event IDs[1,2,3,5]. Lower-bound ID 1 included, upper-bound ID 4 excluded and prior-second ID 6 excluded.
cases.verification: Assert the exact ID set and the 25-hour boundary duration; do not use an inclusive BETWEEN.

cases.title: Keep an unresolved local timestamp as local fields
cases.input_contract: Under bothUTC andAmerica/Los_Angeles, cast 2024-11-03 01:30:00 explicitly to TIMESTAMP_NTZ, inspect its schema and render it as a string. Restore the prior zone.
cases.expected: Both outputs are 2024-11-03 01:30:00 and the type is timestamp_ntz. No epoch or unique instant is claimed.
cases.verification: Assert identical local clock strings and explicit type under both zones, then confirm session restoration.

cases.title: Expose the information lost by a local clock key
cases.input_contract: For the two fold events 2 and 3, compare local formatted labels with their epoch values. Return(label_count, instant_count), retaining original event identity.
cases.expected: One distinct local label but two distinct instants. They must not be deduplicated by the displayed clock.
cases.verification: Assert(1,2) using separately materialized local labels and original epoch evidence.

cases.title: Quarantine invalid timestamps without confusing missingness
cases.input_contract: Build an inline source containing a valid offset timestamp, bad text andNULL. Use try_to_timestamp with the declared offset pattern and classify accepted, malformed_timestamp, missing_timestamp.
cases.expected: IDs 1,2,3 have those reasons respectively;only 1 is accepted while ANSI remains true.
cases.verification: Assert all reason rows, one known timestamp and unchanged ANSI setting.
